narrative:
Portage County has 106,745 registered voters, with 20.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 48.3%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 28.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.4% of registrants.
